evals.prompt: Cut a release. The current version is 1.2.0 and the commit subjects since the last tag are in commits.txt (one per line). Produce the release notes: the next version and a grouped changelog, as a release artifact.
evals.expected_output: A release handoff artifact (type: release) proposing version 1.3.0 — a minor bump because a feat is present and nothing is breaking — with a Keep-a-Changelog changelog: Added (the ranking parameter), Fixed (the cache TTL), Changed (the scorer refactor). The chore and docs commits are omitted as changelog noise.
assertions: The proposed next version is 1.3.0 — a minor bump (a feat is present, nothing is breaking)
The changelog is grouped into Keep-a-Changelog sections (e.g. Added / Changed / Fixed)
The feat is under Added and the fix is under Fixed (entries placed in the right group)
The chore and docs commits are not listed as features or fixes (kept out of the changelog)
The output is a valid release artifact: type release, with a version and a non-empty changelog

evals.prompt: Cut a release. The current version is 2.4.1 and the commit subjects since the last tag are in commits-breaking.txt (one per line). Produce the release notes.
evals.expected_output: A release artifact proposing version 3.0.0 — a major bump because a commit is breaking (feat!: drop the v1 API) — with the breaking change explicitly flagged, plus the two features and the fix grouped under the right Keep-a-Changelog sections.
assertions: The proposed next version is 3.0.0 — a major bump driven by the breaking change
The breaking change (dropping the v1 query API) is explicitly called out as breaking
The non-breaking feature and the fix are grouped under the correct Keep-a-Changelog sections
